hero.headline: Cruthaigh UGC ads for the world's best brands.
hero.body: Cláraigh to work with some of the world's biggest brands — signing up once means you could work with brands like Perplexity, Lovable, Bolt, Hims and more.
hero.footnote: Unsure if it's for you? Check out some of our case studies below.

guide.heading: Nach bhfuil tú cinnte fós an bhfuil sé oiriúnach duit?
guide.body: Féach ar ár dtreoir do chruthaitheoirí – treoir chuimsitheach ar conas ábhar a scannánú a fhaomhtar an chéad uair, agus ar conas oibriú lenár n-ardán.

descriptions.enable_2fa_intro: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the manual key. Then confirm by entering the six-digit code.

descriptions.recovery_codes_warning: Sábháil these one-time codes somewhere safe. They are your only way to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator.
